description: Circular Gauge is a customizable Power BI visual designed to display KPI performance in a simple and intuitive circular format. It enables users to compare Actual values against Target and Previous values while highlighting percentage variance with clear visual indicators. Key features: Display Actual, Target, and Previous values in a single gauge. Show percentage variance with positive and negative indicators. Fully customizable colors, labels, fonts, and formatting. Smooth animations and responsive rendering. Supports Power BI themes and formatting pane options. Ideal for executive dashboards, sales performance, financial reporting, operations monitoring, and KPI tracking. Circular Gauge helps business users quickly understand performance trends and monitor progress toward business goals using a clean and modern visualization.
